list.title: Discoveries
list.dueBanner_one: {{count}} discovery is available to observe when you feel like it ({{days}}+ days).
list.dueBanner_other: {{count}} discoveries are available to observe when you feel like it ({{days}}+ days).
list.earlyHint: Discovery-time values only, within one metric and source. Unknown values appear last.

empty.title: Keep the music you found.
empty.lead: A private archive of independent discoveries: when you found a song, what you heard in it, and what happened afterward. Everything stays in this browser; export JSON backups from Settings.
empty.step1Body: Artist and title are enough. Context, notes and popularity numbers are optional.
empty.step2Body: Add observations whenever you want. The first measurement can come much later.
empty.step3Body: Growth, fulfilled predictions and personally confirmed success each tell a different part of the story. A discovery is worthwhile at any popularity.

form.youtubeHint: Used for the thumbnail and a shortcut. Optional.
form.secEntryHint: All numbers are optional. Record when you actually measured them.
form.baseHint: Growth and the hit rule are measured on this metric.
form.amountHint: 1.2M, 3.4K, 12,345 — and Korean units like 12만 — all work. Growth and hits are measured on the metric marked ‘Base’.
form.amountInvalid: Not a number I can read
form.secWhyHint: Write down what you're hearing. It's the part you'll most want to reread later.
form.notePlaceholder: The way the backing vocals stack up after the second chorus…
form.secTargetHint: Optional. Passing this number counts as a hit, whatever the hit rule (×{{mult}}) says.
form.claimedAtHint: Defaults to the moment you save. You can record an earlier discovery.
form.limitTitle: You've used all {{limit}} picks this month.
form.limitBody: Your saved limit is active. You can change it or choose unlimited in
form.errYoutube: That doesn't look like a YouTube video link
form.errUrl: Use an address starting with http(s)://
form.errTargetLow: Must be higher than the current number
form.errFuture: You can't pick in the future
form.errAfterCheckin: Discovery cannot follow the recorded observation ({{date}})
form.errLimit: That month is already at its limit ({{limit}})
form.optionalDetails: Add context, links, notes or numbers (optional)
form.errObservation: Observation must be between discovery and now.
form.sourceHint: Name the platform and specific video, track release or artist page. A saved source stays fixed for this history; use a separate record for a different source. Unknown past sources stay unknown unless you identify them yourself.

detail.noGrowthYet: Needs two observations at different times and a positive baseline.
detail.chartEmpty: The curve fills in as you check in.
detail.autoHitNote: Stamped automatically when it passed the hit rule. Changing the numbers or the rule re-judges it.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this pick and all its check-ins?
detail.noMetrics: No popularity measurements recorded. This discovery is safely archived.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.lead: Observe whenever you want. Empty fields are skipped. Keep each metric tied to its original platform and release; you can identify its source in Edit.
checkin.emptyDue: Everything was checked within the last {{days}} days.

record.title: Archive history
record.hitRate: share of discoveries with a milestone
record.topEmpty: Rankings appear once you've checked in.
record.topNote: Peak multiple of the base metric · {{checkins}} check-ins in total
record.notableEmpty: Your discoveries are worth keeping, even before growth is measurable.
record.notableHint: Recorded below 10,000 at discovery, later doubled. Grouped by metric and source, newest discovery first; this is not a universal ranking.

small_room.desc: Picked an artist with under 10K monthly listeners.

night_owl.desc: 10 picks made between midnight and 6 a.m.

opening_day.desc: Picked on the 1st of a month.

liftoff.name: Liftoff
liftoff.desc: Doubled within 30 days of the first observation.

viral.name: Viral
viral.desc: Grew 5× within 90 days of the first observation.

crossover.name: Crossover

slow_burn.name: Slow Burn

quick_call.name: Quick Call

hot_streak.name: Hot Streak

clean_sheet.desc: A month with 3+ picks, every one a hit.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.desc: 10+ picks and at least half of them hits.

long_watch.name: Long Watch
long_watch.desc: Kept checking one song for over a year.

liner_notes.name: Liner Notes
liner_notes.desc: 10 picks with a reason over 100 characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hitMultiplierHint: Multiple of the first observed baseline. Recalculates automatic growth milestones; this is not proof of fame.
settings.monthlyLimitHint: 0 means unlimited. Keep an optional limit only if it helps you.
settings.staleDaysHint: A gentle reminder for optional observations, never a deadline.
settings.backupLead: Everything lives in this browser only. Clearing site data erases it, so export a JSON copy now and then.
settings.importInvalid: That isn't an I Told You So backup.
settings.importHint: Merge keeps the more recently edited copy of each pick. Replace all wipes what's here and uses the file.
settings.resetHint_one: Deletes {{count}} pick (since {{since}}) and its check-ins. This can't be undone, so export a JSON copy first.
settings.resetHint_other: Deletes {{count}} picks (since {{since}}) and their check-ins. This can't be undone, so export a JSON copy first.

share.title: Share card
share.coverMissing: YouTube thumbnails can be blocked by browser security rules.
